top_choice_rationale: P003 rewards a rare prediction-then-discovery sequence: the Bistritzer-MacDonald continuum model predicted flat bands at a magic twist angle, and the 2018 observation of correlated insulating and superconducting states there showed that a geometric control parameter switches strong correlations on and off, a mechanism now carried to other moire platforms. The citation can be written around the flat-band prediction and the observed phases without claiming the open pairing mechanism. I hold it with reduced confidence: the experiments are seven to eight years old and the experimental credit to Jarillo-Herrero leaves out Cao and parallel groups. P001 is the safer, more mature choice, but omits Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang and overlaps thematically with 2016; P002 is cleanly attributed and I now accept that the magic-wavelength lattice is a new architecture, but I still weigh it below the other two. A prize is better than none.
